report: 2019/2019.04.17.Operation_Sea_Turtle/DNS Hijacking Abuses Trust In Core Internet Service

removed.reason: The paragraph describes MitM via spoofed webpages and certificate impersonation, not LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning or SMB relay behavior.
It discusses obtaining an impersonating CA-signed X.509 certificate from another provider, not installing a root certificate on a compromised system.
No spearphishing email or malicious link delivery is described; the text only covers credential capture via spoofed MitM webpages.
